candidate.source: Сестра Bestson по отцу, о которой ему раньше не рассказывали; по телефону говорит «я готова приютить брата». Не менять кровное родство на знакомство и не переводить подпись контакта как собственное имя. Персонаж женского пола; использовать женское согласование, сохраняя момент раскрытия в исходной сцене.
candidate.observed: Kapatid na babae ni Bestson sa ama, na hindi dating naikwento sa kanya; sinasabi sa telepono ang ‘я готова приютить брата’, na nangangahulugang handa niyang kupkupin ang kapatid na lalaki. Huwag gawing pagiging magkakilala ang ugnayang kadugo o isalin bilang personal na pangalan ang pangalan sa kontak. Babae ang tauhan; panatilihin ang pagtukoy sa babae at ang sandali ng pagbubunyag sa orihinal na eksena.
candidate.reason: The adjectival predicate handa (ready) takes the focused subject siya. The existing niya is the nonfocused/genitive form and does not express the subject of readiness here. Replace niyang with siyang in the explanatory clause; preserve the Russian quotation and all kinship/source-policy content. This is a grammatical case correction, not gender marking.

supportingReferences.support: Lists siya as the third-person singular focused pronoun. Application to adjectival readiness is reviewer inference.

supportingReferences.support: Native edited government usage includes handa siyang gawin with a patient-voice verb, corroborating the proposed construction.

reason: The initial analysis assigned niya only to the adjective handa. It did not account for the linked patient-voice predicate kupkupin, whose actor can be nonfocused. Native published counterexamples handa niyang gawin and handa niyang tanggapin refute an unconditional ban on niya here. A handa siyang positive control does not establish the other construction ungrammatical. No demonstrable difference in this complete clause supports a required correction.
